name: The Deploy Log
description: Every deployment deployedbyai has carried. Every item sourced to the publisher's own page.

license.attribution: The Deploy Log, deployedbyai, https://deployedbyai.com/log/, licensed CC BY 4.0

dictionary.name: row_key
dictionary.description: The row's key: 12 lowercase hexadecimal characters, drawn at random when the row enters the record and kept for the life of the row.

dictionary.name: company
dictionary.description: The name of the company the row is filed under, as its company page names it.

dictionary.name: subject
dictionary.description: What the row is about, in a few words: the heading of the row's own page.

dictionary.name: what_shipped
dictionary.description: The row's one sentence on what shipped, as its own page prints it.

dictionary.name: lane
dictionary.description: The lane the row is filed in: Models and APIs; Tools and products; Robotics, hardware and chips; Breakthroughs; Funding and acquisitions. Null for an edition's lead, which is filed in no lane.

dictionary.name: edition_n
dictionary.description: The number of the edition that carried the row. Null for a row no edition has carried.

dictionary.name: edition_date
dictionary.description: The date of the edition that carried the row, as YYYY-MM-DD. Null for a row no edition has carried.

dictionary.name: published_date
dictionary.description: The date the publisher's own page gives, as YYYY-MM-DD, on a row no edition carries. Null on a row an edition carries, which is dated by its edition.

dictionary.name: date_label
dictionary.description: The row's date in words: Published and the publisher's date where the row has one; otherwise Edition, the edition's number, a comma and the edition's date.

dictionary.name: source
dictionary.description: The source the row cites, in words: the publisher and its page, as the row's source line prints it.

dictionary.name: source_url
dictionary.description: The URL of the publisher's own page the row is sourced to.

dictionary.name: record_url
dictionary.description: The row's own page on The Deploy Log, with ?k=data, the key that marks a visit as coming from this file.

dictionary.name: added_at
dictionary.description: When the row entered the record, an ISO 8601 timestamp in UTC. It is not the day the thing shipped.

dictionary.name: models
dictionary.description: The ids of the AI models the row's subject names, read by the matcher the model pages use, in the order the subject names them: each is the 12 lowercase hexadecimal characters of the model's page, the page at /log/model/ followed by that id. A model has a page only when rows from 2 or more companies name it; one below that still carries its id here, and the week and month pages count it among the models seen for the first time. Empty when the subject names none. In the CSV, the ids joined by semicolons.

dictionary.name: platforms
dictionary.description: The ids of the platforms the row's subject or what_shipped names, read by the matcher the platform pages use, in the order of the record's list of platforms: each is the 12 lowercase hexadecimal characters of the platform's page, the page at /log/platform/ followed by that id. A platform has a page only when 10 or more rows from 2 or more companies name it, 10 or more of them from companies other than its owners; one below that still carries its id here. A row that names a platform did not necessarily ship on it. Empty when the row names none. In the CSV, the ids joined by semicolons.

rows.what_shipped: Apps in ChatGPT launched with the Apps SDK preview, an open standard built on the Model Context Protocol. Booking.com, Canva, Coursera, Figma, Expedia, Spotify, and Zillow are live today for logged-in users outside the EEA, Switzerland, and the UK.
rows.source: OpenAI, Introducing apps in ChatGPT and the new Apps SDK

rows.subject: Deloitte Claude alliance
rows.what_shipped: Anthropic and Deloitte expanded their alliance to make Claude available to more than 470,000 Deloitte people and to train and certify 15,000 professionals on Claude.
rows.source: Anthropic, Deloitte will make Claude available to 470,000 people across its global network

rows.subject: ChatGPT apps on Vercel
rows.what_shipped: Vercel now supports building and deploying ChatGPT apps with Next.js, using MCP natively in the OpenAI sandbox.
rows.source: Vercel, ChatGPT apps support on Vercel

rows.subject: Codex
rows.what_shipped: Codex is generally available with Slack integration, SDK, and admin tools. Daily usage grew 10x since early August; GPT-5-Codex served over 40 trillion tokens in three weeks. Cisco reports 50% faster code reviews.
rows.source: OpenAI, Codex is now generally available

rows.subject: Claude Sonnet 4.5
rows.what_shipped: Claude Sonnet 4.5 is available everywhere today at $3/$15 per million tokens, the same price as Claude Sonnet 4. It leads OSWorld at 61.4% and maintains focus for more than 30 hours on complex tasks.
rows.source: Anthropic, Introducing Claude Sonnet 4.5

rows.subject: Instant Checkout
rows.what_shipped: U.S. ChatGPT Plus, Pro, and Free users can now buy directly from U.S. Etsy sellers in chat, with over a million Shopify merchants like Glossier, SKIMS, Spanx and Vuori coming soon. The Agentic Commerce Protocol is open sourced today.
rows.source: OpenAI, Buy it in ChatGPT: Instant Checkout and the Agentic Commerce Protocol

rows.subject: Qwen3-8B agent speedup
rows.what_shipped: OpenVINO.GenAI accelerates Qwen3-8B generation by about 1.4x on Intel Core Ultra using speculative decoding with a depth-pruned Qwen3-0.6B draft model.
rows.source: Hugging Face, Accelerating Qwen3-8B Agent on Intel Core Ultra with Depth-Pruned Draft Models

rows.subject: RTEB benchmark
rows.what_shipped: RTEB is a new retrieval embedding benchmark in beta that combines open and private datasets across 20 languages and domains like law, healthcare, code, and finance, using NDCG@10 as the default metric.
rows.source: Hugging Face, Introducing RTEB: A New Standard for Retrieval Evaluation

rows.subject: Sora 2
rows.what_shipped: Sora 2 is a video and audio generation model with synchronized dialogue and sound effects, more accurate physics, and a characters feature that inserts a recorded person into generated scenes. The Sora iOS app is available to download now with initial rollout in the U.S. and Canada.
rows.source: OpenAI, Sora 2 is here

rows.subject: Sora 2 System Card
rows.what_shipped: Sora 2 is available via sora.com, in a new standalone iOS Sora app, and in the future it will be available via the API, with initial access rolling out through limited invitations.
rows.source: OpenAI, Sora 2 System Card

rows.subject: uv Python builds
rows.what_shipped: Vercel now uses uv as the default package manager for all Python builds, making builds 30-65% faster and adding support for uv.lock and pyproject.toml dependency files.
rows.source: Vercel, Python package manager uv is now available for builds

rows.subject: dots.ocr on-device
rows.what_shipped: Hugging Face converted dots.ocr, a 3B parameter model that surpasses Gemini 2.5 Pro on OmniDocBench, to Core ML and MLX, but the initial conversion is over 5GB and slow.
rows.source: Hugging Face, SOTA OCR with Core ML and dots.ocr

rows.subject: Parental controls
rows.what_shipped: OpenAI launched parental controls for ChatGPT, letting parents link accounts, set quiet hours, disable voice, memory, image generation, and opt out of training.
rows.source: OpenAI, Introducing parental controls

rows.subject: CDN request collapsing
rows.what_shipped: The Vercel CDN now collapses over 3M requests per day on cache miss, on top of 90M collapsed requests from background revalidations, using node and regional distributed locks with three second timeouts.
rows.source: Vercel, Preventing the stampede: Request collapsing in the Vercel CDN

rows.subject: ChatGPT Pulse
rows.what_shipped: ChatGPT Pulse preview released to Pro users on mobile. ChatGPT does asynchronous research each night from memory, chat history, feedback, and connected Gmail or Google Calendar, then delivers personalized visual cards once a day.
rows.source: OpenAI, Introducing ChatGPT Pulse

rows.subject: External API queries
rows.what_shipped: Observability Plus query builder now supports custom queries on request counts or time to first byte for external API calls such as fetch requests to an AI provider, with TTFB breakdowns by average, min, max, p75, p90, p95, and p99.
rows.source: Vercel, Query data on external API requests in Vercel Observability

rows.subject: Waymo for Business
rows.what_shipped: Waymo for Business invites organizations to sign up after pilots, with over a million trips every month and nearly 1 in 6 local riders in San Francisco, Los Angeles, and Phoenix using Waymo to commute to work or school.
rows.source: Waymo, Waymo for Business: Trusted Daily Rides for Organizations

rows.subject: GDPval
rows.what_shipped: GDPval evaluates models on 1,320 tasks across 44 occupations, finding frontier models approach expert quality and complete tasks 100x faster and cheaper.
rows.source: OpenAI, Measuring the performance of our models on real-world tasks

rows.subject: Shared projects and connectors
rows.what_shipped: Shared projects for Business, Enterprise, Edu plans; new connectors to Gmail, Calendar, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, GitHub, Dropbox, Box; ISO 27001/27017/27018/27701 certifications; SOC 2 expanded.
rows.source: OpenAI, More ways to work with your team and tools in ChatGPT

rows.subject: Zero-config FastAPI
rows.what_shipped: FastAPI is now supported with zero-configuration on Vercel, using Fluid compute with Active CPU pricing by default.
rows.source: Vercel, Zero-config FastAPI backends

rows.subject: Claude in Xcode
rows.what_shipped: Developers can connect their Claude account to Xcode 26 to power coding intelligence features with Claude Sonnet 4. The integration includes a coding assistant and Coding Tools for documentation, explanations, SwiftUI previews, and inline code changes.
rows.source: Anthropic, Claude is now generally available in Xcode

rows.subject: GPT-5-Codex
rows.what_shipped: GPT-5-Codex is a version of GPT-5 optimized for agentic coding in Codex. It is the default for cloud tasks and code review, and developers can choose it for local tasks via Codex CLI and the IDE extension.
rows.source: OpenAI, Introducing upgrades to Codex

rows.subject: LeRobotDataset v3.0
rows.what_shipped: LeRobotDataset v3.0 packs multiple episodes in a single file using relational metadata, and natively supports streaming mode to process large datasets on the fly without downloading prohibitively large collections onto disk.
rows.source: Hugging Face, LeRobotDataset:v3.0: Bringing large-scale datasets to lerobot

rows.subject: Notion 3.0
rows.what_shipped: Notion 3.0 rebuilds Notion AI as Agents that can take on a whole project, break it into tasks, assign them, and draft docs. Agents can update or create hundreds of pages at once across databases.
rows.source: Notion, Releases / September 18, 2025 3.0 Notion 3.0: Agents

rows.subject: Scaleway Inference Provider
rows.what_shipped: Scaleway is now a supported Inference Provider on the Hugging Face Hub, offering serverless access to models like gpt-oss, Qwen3, DeepSeek R1, and Gemma 3 with pay-per-token pricing starting at €0.20 per million tokens.
rows.source: Hugging Face, Scaleway on Hugging Face Inference Providers

rows.subject: Vercel Bloom filter routing
rows.what_shipped: Vercel replaced a slow JSON parsing operation with a Bloom filter in its global routing service, reducing memory usage by 15% and improving time-to-first-byte from the 75th percentile and above by 10%.
rows.source: Vercel, How we made global routing faster with Bloom filters

rows.subject: Vercel Drains
rows.what_shipped: Vercel Log Drains are now Vercel Drains, exporting OpenTelemetry traces, Web Analytics events, and Speed Insights metrics alongside logs, with data billed at $0.50 per GB on Pro and Enterprise plans.
rows.source: Vercel, Introducing Vercel Drains

rows.subject: Vercel Fluid cold starts
rows.what_shipped: Vercel delivers zero cold starts for 99.37% of all requests through scale to one, Fluid compute, predictive scaling, bytecode caching, and rolling releases, with single instances handling peaks above 250 concurrent requests.
rows.source: Vercel, Scale to one: How Fluid solves cold starts

rows.subject: Vercel build cache
rows.what_shipped: Vercel improved its build cache performance by downloading parts of the cache in parallel using a worker pool, decreasing build initialization time by 30% on average and reducing build times by up to 7 seconds for all plans.
rows.source: Vercel, Builds now start up to 30% faster

rows.subject: AI code reviews beta
rows.what_shipped: Vercel Agent can now conduct code reviews with validated suggestions, available in public beta for all Pro and Enterprise teams with a $100 Vercel Agent credit.
rows.source: Vercel, AI Code Reviews by Vercel Agent now in beta

rows.subject: Image Services on Bedrock
rows.what_shipped: Stability AI launched Image Services on Amazon Bedrock, offering nine editing tools like Inpaint, Erase, and Remove Background as managed API services for enterprise workflows.
rows.source: Stability AI, Stability AI Brings Image Services to Amazon Bedrock

rows.subject: Public AI Inference Provider
rows.what_shipped: Public AI is now a supported Inference Provider on Hugging Face, offering free access to public and sovereign models like Apertus-70B, with usage free of charge at the time of writing.
rows.source: Hugging Face, Public AI on Hugging Face Inference Providers

rows.subject: Waymo in Nashville
rows.what_shipped: Waymo will launch fully autonomous rides in Nashville in partnership with Lyft, starting operations in the coming months and opening to public riders next year.
rows.source: Waymo, Waymo is coming to Nashville in partnership with Lyft
